## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit, and e2e for layout / accessibility changes)
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] A changeset is included if a published package changes (`npm run changeset`)
- [ ] Docs updated if the public API changed
- [ ] New UI is keyboard-operable, has accessible names and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
